# InferenceGateway resource configuration reference

@include 'alerts/enterprise-alert.mdx'

This topic provides reference information for the `InferenceGateway` custom resource. An `InferenceGateway` is the entry point for AI inference traffic in a namespace. It references an [`InferencePoolConfig`](/consul/docs/reference/k8s/ai/inferencepoolconfig) resource that defines the pool of model backends, rate-limit rules, and routing policy that the gateway enforces. For each `InferenceGateway`, the controller creates a Deployment, a Service, and a Consul `inference-gateway` configuration entry.

Refer to [Configure the AI Inference Gateway](/consul/docs/agentic-mesh/model-access/configure) for usage information.

## Configuration model

The following list outlines the field hierarchy, data types, and requirements for the `InferenceGateway` resource. Click a property name to view additional details, including default values.

- [`apiVersion`](#apiversion): string | required | must be set to `consul.hashicorp.com/v1alpha1`
- [`kind`](#kind): string | required | must be set to `InferenceGateway`
- [`metadata`](#metadata): map | required
   - [`name`](#metadata-name): string | required
   - [`namespace`](#metadata-namespace): string
- [`spec`](#spec): map | required
   - [`poolRef`](#spec-poolref): map | required
      - [`name`](#spec-poolref-name): string | required
   - [`image`](#spec-image): string
   - [`replicas`](#spec-replicas): integer
   - [`resources`](#spec-resources): map
      - [`limits`](#spec-resources-limits): map
      - [`requests`](#spec-resources-requests): map
   - [`logLevel`](#spec-loglevel): string
   - [`service`](#spec-service): map
      - [`type`](#spec-service-type): string
      - [`ports`](#spec-service-ports): list
         - [`port`](#spec-service-ports-port): integer | required

## Complete configuration

When every field is defined, an `InferenceGateway` resource has the following form:

```yaml
apiVersion: consul.hashicorp.com/v1alpha1
kind: InferenceGateway
metadata:
  name: <name for this resource>
  namespace: <namespace>
spec:
  poolRef:
    name: <string>
  image: <string>
  replicas: <integer>
  resources:
    limits: <map>
    requests: <map>
  logLevel: <trace | debug | info | warn | error>
  service:
    type: <ClusterIP | NodePort | LoadBalancer>
    ports:
      - port: <integer>
```

## Specification

This section describes the fields you can configure in the `InferenceGateway` resource.

### `apiVersion`

Specifies the API version of the resource.

#### Values

- Default: None
- This field is required.
- Data type: String value that must be set to `consul.hashicorp.com/v1alpha1`.

### `kind`

Specifies the type of resource.

#### Values

- Default: None
- This field is required.
- Data type: String value that must be set to `InferenceGateway`.

### `metadata`

Map that contains the name and namespace for the resource.

#### Values

- Default: None
- This field is required.
- Data type: Map

### `metadata.name`

Specifies the name of the resource.

#### Values

- Default: None
- This field is required.
- Data type: String

### `metadata.namespace`

Specifies the Kubernetes namespace for the resource.

#### Values

- Default: The namespace of the current Kubernetes context.
- Data type: String

### `spec`

InferenceGatewaySpec defines the desired state of InferenceGateway.

#### Values

- Default: None
- This field is required.
- Data type: Map

### `spec.poolRef`

poolRef references the InferencePoolConfig this gateway fronts. The controller uses this reference to look up the full pool configuration (backends, rate-limit rules, routing policy) at reconcile time. The referenced pool must exist in the same namespace.

#### Values

- Default: None
- This field is required.
- Data type: Map

### `spec.poolRef.name`

name is the name of the InferencePoolConfig to attach to.

#### Values

- Default: None
- This field is required.
- Data type: String

### `spec.image`

image is the container image to run for the gateway Deployment. When set, this overrides the default image configured on the controller. Must be a fully-qualified image reference, e.g. "hashicorp/consul-ai-gateway:1.0.0".

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: String

### `spec.replicas`

replicas is the desired number of gateway Deployment replicas. Defaults to 1 when not set.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Integer
- Minimum: `0`

### `spec.resources`

resources sets the compute resource requests and limits for the gateway container. When not set the controller uses the cluster-level defaults configured through Helm (ai.inferenceGateway.resources).

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `spec.resources.limits`

Limits describes the maximum amount of compute resources allowed.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `spec.resources.requests`

Requests describes the minimum amount of compute resources required.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `spec.logLevel`

logLevel sets the log verbosity of the inference-gateway process. Valid values: trace, debug, info, warn, error. Defaults to info when not set.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: String value set to one of the following:
  - `trace`
  - `debug`
  - `info`
  - `warn`
  - `error`

### `spec.service`

service configures the ClusterIP Service fronting the gateway Deployment. When not set the controller uses the cluster-level defaults configured through Helm (ai.inferenceGateway.defaults.service).

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `spec.service.type`

type is the Kubernetes Service type. Defaults to ClusterIP.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: String value set to one of the following:
  - `ClusterIP`
  - `NodePort`
  - `LoadBalancer`

### `spec.service.ports`

ports is the list of ports exposed by the Service. The first entry is used as the primary inference traffic port.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: List

### `spec.service.ports.port`

port number exposed on the Service.

#### Values

- Default: None
- This field is required.
- Data type: Integer
- Minimum: `1`
- Maximum: `65535`
